newsitem.title: USA: HSN names Jed Trosper CFO.
newsitem.headline: HSN names Jed Trosper CFO.

text.p: HSN Inc said on Tuesday it named Jed Trosper, the chief financial officer of Home Shopping Network, as CFO of HSN.
HSN is the parent company of the recently-merged Home Shopping Network, Silver King Broadcasting and SF Broadcasting.

The previously announced appointments of Barry Diller as chairman, James Held, who is president and chief executive officer, as vice chairman and Victor Kaufman as office of the chairman, were confirmed, the company said.
James Gallagher was also named vice president, general counsel and secretary of HSN Inc, it said.
